component.name: Flasher
component.summary: Write disk images to USB drives and SD cards

description.p: Flasher writes Raspberry Pi OS, Linux distributions, Windows installers and any .img, .iso or compressed image to a USB drive or SD card, and reads it back to check it.

ul.li: Checks the download against its published SHA-256 before touching the drive
Writes disk images byte for byte; copies Windows installer ISOs onto FAT32
Only offers removable drives, never the disk the system runs from
Turns a flashed drive back into an ordinary exFAT drive
